name: Ideal Group of Companies Inc.
summary: Ideal Group of Companies Inc. functions as a media technology firm, concentrating its primary operations on the digital media sector. Within this digital domain, the company delivers a wide array of services, encompassing online platforms and applications, original content development, digital marketing strategies, video streaming services, publishing endeavors, and free broadcast television programming specifically tailored for active adults aged 55 and above. Beyond its media activities, the organization also dedicates efforts to making strategic acquisitions in the biotechnology and bioscience fields, particularly those focused on extending human lifespan and promoting longevity. This entity, which was previously named JZZ Technologies, Inc., officially adopted its current designation, Ideal Group of Companies Inc., in January 2024. Its corporate base is situated in Anderson, South Carolina.
